heading: 16.1 Design principles
text:
### 16.1 Design principles [LUNI.16.1]

- No unit is declared in more than one module with a different conversion factor.
  Same quantity appearing in multiple modules (e.g. `grain` in both
  `units.avoirdupois` and `units.troy`) resolves to the same numeric value. A program still
  imports it from one of them: importing it from both is refused ([LIMP.5.1.5]).
- `units.imperial` means UK imperial. `units.customary` means US customary.
  These are distinct modules because many unit names (gallon, pint, fl oz,
  hundredweight, ton) differ in value between the two systems.
- Import order never chooses between two units ([LIMP.5.1.5]). A program that
  needs a name two modules declare reaches each by qualified access
  (`avoirdupois.grain`, `troy.grain`).
- No module re-exports another's declarations. Authors import what they need.
